name: rxchain
description: RxChain — blockchain drug supply-chain tracking and anti-counterfeiting

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w contracts && npm run test -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && prettier --check .
